campaignIntro: This SEO campaign is focused on improving Shift Physiotherapy’s visibility for local physiotherapy searches and helping more patients find the practice online.
Each month, we monitor technical site health, keyword visibility, and on-page opportunities to strengthen search performance and support sustainable organic growth.
monthlyRecap: September was an important transition month for Shift as we prepared to take over management of the Google Ads account while continuing to strengthen the site’s SEO foundation. We reviewed the existing campaigns, conversion tracking and supporting website setup, and we’re excited to begin managing Google Ads directly so we can better connect the advertising strategy with the SEO and content work already underway.

recap: As we take over management of Shift’s Google Ads account, our first priority will be improving the quality of the data Google is using to optimize the campaigns. The account is currently tracking a number of different actions as conversions, so we’ll begin by separating true lead and booking activity from lower-value engagement actions. From there, we’ll refine campaign structure, search terms, targeting, scheduling and landing-page alignment so budget is focused more heavily on the searches and services that are most likely to generate actual appointments.

This first month of management will be focused on getting the account’s foundation right before making larger changes to bidding or budgets. Once conversion tracking is cleaned up and we have a clearer picture of which campaigns and searches are producing actual bookings, we’ll be able to make more informed decisions about automated bidding, budget allocation and where additional advertising spend can generate the strongest return.
googleAds.title: Google Ads Management

priorities.description: Review all current conversion actions and prioritize completed Jane bookings, qualified calls and meaningful lead submissions so campaign optimization is based on real patient acquisition rather than softer engagement signals.
Audit the Pelvic Floor, Physio and Dry Needling campaigns, identify high-performing search terms, reduce wasted spend and tighten keyword targeting around strong local service intent.
Confirm ads are focused on the Edmonton-area locations Shift actually wants to serve and remove any unnecessary geographic reach that could be wasting budget.

Review when leads and bookings are occurring, adjust ad schedules where appropriate, and assess how the current budget should be distributed between the three active campaigns. Pelvic Floor will receive particular attention because it is currently the strongest and most budget-constrained campaign.
Coordinate the dedicated Pelvic Health landing page with the campaign and review the ad-to-page experience so messaging, services and calls to action closely match the searches driving each campaign.

nextSteps: In October, we’ll continue adding fresh, optimized content and expand the internal linking strategy across more pages and blog posts. We’ll also begin cleaning up Google Tag Manager and the Google Ads account so conversion tracking, campaign data and future optimizations are built on a cleaner and more reliable foundation.
